info.name: CYCLES_RENDERER_INTERACTIVE_SCALING
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: device-side emulation of the Cycles viewport resolution divider for fast interaction. When enabled and the frame uses 'accumulation', any frame that restarts accumulation (camera/scene change) renders at a divider-scaled resolution and is upscaled (nearest) into the full-resolution channels; the next unchanged frame renders once at full resolution restarting accumulation from sample 0, then refinement proceeds as usual. Default off: behavior is then bit-identical to not having the extension.

parameters.name: interactiveScaling
parameters.description: render accumulation-reset (camera/scene change) frames at reduced resolution, upscaled to the frame size; only engages while the frame's 'accumulation' is enabled. Preview frames upscale all channels, so depth/id channels are blocky until interaction stops

parameters.name: interactiveScalingDivider
parameters.description: fixed resolution divider for preview frames (1 disables scaling); 0 picks a power-of-two divider automatically from the previous full-resolution frame time, targeting 'interactiveScalingTargetFrameTime' (capped at 8, long image axis kept >= 128 pixels)

parameters.name: interactiveScalingTargetFrameTime
parameters.description: target preview frame time in seconds for the automatic divider selection (default ~1/30 s, matching the Cycles viewport heuristic)
